# Cncf Kubefwd Reviewer

Review kubefwd using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. Bulk port forwarding Kubernetes services to localhost with unique loopback IPs, enabling multiple services on the same port without conflicts.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
